title: Attaining Fundamental Limits of Multiparameter Incoherent Optical Imaging Using Joint-Detection Quantum Measurements
summary: Resolving extended incoherent objects below the diffraction limit poses an application-rich imaging challenge whose solution may enable a new generation of observational instruments and capabilities. In this work, we invoke a practical model for general imaging by approximating an arbitrary extended incoherent object as a finite grid of thermal point emitters parameterized by their brightnesses.
